trips</h3><p class="pv-home-feature-text">Student groups, corporate retreats, wind sports camps, fishing trips, liveaboards, and eco adventures across Baja.</p></article><article class="pv-home-feature-card"><a class="pv-home-feature-image" href="https://www.palapasventana.com/resort/"><img src="https://www.palapasventana.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image.png" alt="Our resort" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a><h3 class="pv-home-feature-title">Our resort</h3><p class="pv-home-feature-text">Casitas, pool, spa, and on-site dining on La Ventana Bay - your base camp for everything Baja.</p></article><article class="pv-home-feature-card"><a class="pv-home-feature-image" href="https://www.palapasventana.com/liveaboards/"><img src="https://www.palapasventana.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/c5198a1a-a728-43fd-b17b-fb727dff631f.jpg" alt="Liveaboards" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a><h3 class="pv-home-feature-title">Liveaboards</h3><p class="pv-home-feature-text">Luxury cat liveaboards for wind sports, scuba, fishing, and nature - crewed by our pro captains.</p></article><article class="pv-home-feature-card"><a class="pv-home-feature-image" href="https://www.palapasventana.com/mag-bay/"><img src="https://www.palapasventana.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/mag-bay-food.jpg" alt="Magdalena Bay" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a><h3 class="pv-home-feature-title">Magdalena Bay</h3><p class="pv-home-feature-text">Fly fishing, spearfishing, R&amp;R fishing, gray whales, and diving at our Mag Bay outpost.</p></article></div></section><section class="pv-home-about" aria-label="About Palapas Ventana"><div class="pv-home-wrap pv-home-about-grid"><div class="pv-home-about-copy"><h2 class="pv-home-section-title">Join us on a barefoot adventure you'll never forget</h2><p class="pv-home-body">Welcome to Palapas Ventana, the Best of Baja. We are an Ocean Adventure Resort in La Ventana Bay in the Sea of Cortez, Baja Mexico. We are located just 35 minutes southeast of La Paz between La Ventana and El Sargento. Our family-run resort features custom service small-town charm and incredible water sports.</p><p class="pv-home-body">Come experience our world-class Spearfishing, Fishing, Kiteboarding, Scuba... or just relax and enjoy incredible turquoise water, amazing sunrises and sunsets, friendly Mexican culture, foods with unforgettable flavors, and a time to just "be in the moment".</p><p class="pv-home-body">Join the Hatler family on a barefoot adventure you'll never forget... the only hard part is leaving.</p></div><div class="pv-home-about-media"><img src="https://www.palapasventana.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/laventana_aerial_a.webp" alt="Aerial view of Palapas Ventana and La Ventana Bay" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div></div></section><section class="pv-home-about pv-home-captains-band" aria-label="Meet your captains"><div class="pv-home-wrap pv-home-about-grid pv-home-about-grid-reverse"><div class="pv-home-about-media"><a href="https://www.palapasventana.com/captains-profiles/" aria-label="Meet your captains"><img src="https://www.palapasventana.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/meet-your-captains-3.jpg" alt="Palapas Ventana captain with a fresh catch on La Ventana Bay" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a></div><div class="pv-home-about-copy"><h2 class="pv-home-section-title">Meet your captains</h2><p class="pv-home-body">Our captains are the hands on the helm - decades on the Sea of Cortez from El Sargento to Agua Amarga. Wahlo, Pedro, Juan, Randell, Brayán, and the crew specialize in rod and reel, fly fishing, spearfishing, diving, snorkeling, and wildlife days, with tournament-proven service and local knowledge you feel from the first cast.</p><p class="pv-home-body">Book a day with the team that lives these waters - patient boat placement, serious fish, and the same hospitality that defines Palapas Ventana.</p><p class="pv-home-body"><a class="pv-home-btn" href="https://www.palapasventana.com/captains-profiles/">Meet the captains</a></p></div></div></section><section class="pv-home-partners"
